item.title: F1: Season's last word
item.description: The climax of an extraordinary season will play out in Abu Dhabi on Sunday, which will conclude a narrative with multiple threads: Of Piastri’s fall from peak, Norris’s rise to the top, and most captivatingly, the gritty Verstappen scripting a magical turnaround

item.title: Magisterial probe ordered into Goa nightclub fire; FIR lodged against owner, GM
item.description: The fire broke out at Birch by Romeo Lane after midnight. The popular party venue at Arpora village, located around 25 km from the state capital Panaji, opened last year.

item.title: Massive fire destroys 10 fishing boats in Kerala's Kollam
item.description: The incident happened in the Kureepuzha area under the Anchalumood police station limit.

item.title: DGCA gives 24 hours to IndiGo CEO to explain what led to mega fiasco at airline
item.description: The aviation regulator has sought explanation from him within 24 hours on why enforcement action should not be initiated against him after widespread IndiGo delays and cancellations disrupted air travel across the country.

item.title: Chennai sees 100 IndiGo flights cancelled in a single day
item.description: Passengers in Chennai continue to bear the brunt of the chaos as IndiGo’s cancellations stretch into a sixth straight day.

item.title: NATO's Arctic activities pose security threat to Russia: Ambassador
item.description: Meanwhile, the Russian forces carried out a "massive strike" on Ukraine's military-industrial complex, energy facilities and port infrastructure, the Russian defence ministry said Saturday.

item.title: Massive fire erupts at GST commissioner’s office in Anna Nagar
item.description: According to a Daily Thanthi report, the blaze started on the ground floor of the building and quickly spread to other sections.

item.title: Global events, inflation data, FII trends likely to drive Indian markets next week
item.description: Additionally, fresh developments in India–Russia relations and movement in key economic indicators such as loan growth and forex reserves are likely to keep traders on alert.

item.title: Kareena Kapoor provides an insight into her parenting philosophy: 'Character is forever'
item.description: Bebo wished for her boys to be able to love those who seem a little different, because she feels that, at the end, every professional achievement in life fades, but it is only one's character that stands the test of time.

item.title: Armed Forces Flag Day: PM Modi expressed gratitude to Armed Forces
item.description: The prime minister also made a contribution to the Armed Forces Flag Day Fund.
